text:
Type: natural cowhide rug
Use: layering on a floor, beside a sofa or bed; living room, bedroom, study
Style: rustic, bohemian, mid-century modern
Materials: natural cowhide with short smooth hair
Colors: warm reddish brown, darker chestnut shading along the spine
Shape: irregular organic hide outline with curved edges and leg points, flat and thin, one-of-a-kind markings, medium visual weight
Feel: warm, earthy, natural, rich
Goes with: leather, dark or warm wood, cream and rust tones; rustic, farmhouse or mid-century rooms

product.name: KOLDBY
product.description: The cowhide is naturally durable and will last for many years.
